other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must be an ordinary resident of Assam.
Applicant must be a journalist formally accredited/recognized by the Director of Information & Public Relations (DIPR) and must fulfil all accreditation norms.
Financial assistance is not a right; it is subject to the committee’s satisfaction, merit of the case, and availability of funds.
The committee may reject or accept any application without assigning any reasons.
benefits_summary: One‑time financial assistance up to ₹50,000 for non‑life‑threatening ailments and up to ₹1,00,000 for life‑threatening ailments, provided to accredited journalists and their dependent family members.
